name: Dark Genie's Gauntlet (Roguelike)
author: Jeffiest
description: A roguelike game mode on the title menu. Dark Genie's Gauntlet has its own title screen and its own progress: Start Run begins a fresh game that belongs to no save file and drops you onto the first floor of a forward-only run through five biomes, three floors and a Warden each. Cursed Gates, fast ABS, one weapon each (a broken one ends the run), an in-run Diorama, drafted allies and Moon Shards for the Norune Eternal unlocks. Needs the MoonFactory engine with title modes.

settings.name: Biomes per run
settings.description: Divine Beast Cave, Wise Owl Forest, Shipwreck, Sun and Moon Temple and Moon Sea, in that order.

settings.name: Shuffle biome order
settings.description: Biomes come in a random order; a late biome rolled early has its enemies and their hits scaled down.

settings.name: Enemy HP per floor of depth (%)
Shuffled floors: after 1-1 each floor is in a random dungeon
New moves
settings.description: New animated attacks, an L2 evade and combos. Toan: Dash Slash, Spinning Sweep, Counter Slash, roll and backstep. Xiao: Triple Shot, tumble and hop shot. Goro and Ungaga get a melee set, Ruby and Osmond a set of shots. R2 is a heavy attack; A,A,R2 and A,A,A,R2 are finishers; locked on, toward or away + A lunge in or strike backing off; A out of an evade follows it up. The evades also cut an attack short once its blow lands.

settings.name: Weapon rarity, touches and legendaries
settings.description: Found weapons roll Common to Legendary: stronger stats, a coloured name and glow, and touches such as Vampire, Poison or Thunder Chain.

settings.name: Chance a Warden is the dungeon's own boss (%)
settings.description: Dran, Master Utan, the Ice Queen, King's Curse or Minotaur Joe, each with its own cast; otherwise the floor's toughest monster grows into the Warden.

settings.name: Finale: the Genie's Lair after the last Warden
settings.description: One more floor after the last biome's Warden. The Dark Genie fights there in his pink form and his dark elemental form: one after the other in either order, or both at once, each with a random share of its spells. Beating him wins the run.

settings.name: Rest floor between biomes
settings.description: After each Warden but the last: a hall with a healing spring and Gaffer's shop, then two ways on. The exit gate leads to the next biome as usual; the stairs in the side room take the Cursed Path, where every floor of that biome before its Warden is cursed (richer chests, a Miracle cache each, and a Warden that pays out twice).

settings.name: Chance a floor has a boss roaming it (%)
settings.description: One of the dungeons' bosses, with its cast, as a regular monster: smaller, with a modest HP pool. Never on a Warden floor.

settings.name: Warden HP (percent of the boss table: x10, x20, x35, x60, x100 by biome)
Move tips: each character's controls when they join a run
Opar joins the roster (in development)
settings.description: A seventh hero for new runs: Opar, the frog mage, with his own staffs, moves and voice. He can be drafted or chosen as the starting character. Without this setting, he joins once his star in Norune Eternal's Allies is bought (it rises when a run beats the Moon Sea Warden). Runs only: he is never written to a save.

settings.name: Companion: a drafted ally fights beside you
settings.description: Needs the Eternal tree's Companion. Off: drafted allies wait on the bench until you switch to them.

settings.name: Also show the run on Journal > Character (Start opens the run menu)
